scope: Every currently available bound part verified against current blob SHA/bytes. Only conversation/user text is inspected for exact synthetic ID/instance/quoted request presence; no body copied.
limits: Latest per-turn snapshots, not every request. Full first/intermediate HTTP bodies not retained or rehashed.
Repeated A request presence counts are evidence of preserved history/current input, not exactly-once provider delivery.
Wire metadata is pre-dispatch serialization provenance, not independent provider acceptance proof.
